notes:
{漏|も}らす means to let something escape or slip out, either physically or informationally.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {漏|も}れる (intransitive, something leaks out)

MEANINGS:
1. Physical leaking: {水|みず}を{漏|も}らす (to leak water)
2. Information: {秘密|ひみつ}を{漏|も}らす (to divulge a secret)
3. Omitting: {名前|なまえ}を{漏|も}らす (to leave out a name)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {秘密|ひみつ}を{漏|も}らす: to let slip a secret
- {情報|じょうほう}を{漏|も}らす: to leak information
- {本音|ほんね}を{漏|も}らす: to let one's true feelings slip
- ため{息|いき}を{漏|も}らす: to let out a sigh
